method.execution: Sequential scrypt calls using the same 64-byte key length and Node defaults as the application; a 1 ms interval observes event-loop availability.
method.source: Executed locally through PowerShell stdin piped into node. Synthetic password and salt only.

interpretation: Async password derivation keeps the event loop available while retaining the existing hash format and cryptographic parameters.
limitations: One local sample per mode; timings vary with machine load.
This is an event-loop availability measurement, not a production HTTP throughput benchmark.
External PostgreSQL, Redis and production load were not exercised by this measurement.
